subject: [PATCH 1/2] nfsd: Report vetted delegated timestamps in GETATTR replies

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue in the NFS server where vetted delegated timestamps were being overridden, leading to incorrect file modification times being reported to clients. The override was done by nfsd4_encode_fattr4(), but the vetting had already been performed by cb_getattr_update_times(). By removing the override, the patch ensures that only valid and vetted timestamps are returned in GETATTR responses.
